snippet.title: C64 Rupert And The Ice Castle longplay
snippet.description: I played this game to cool myself during the summer, but I was soon steaming due to the unresponsive controls and the extremely short duration. I wouldn't have been happy if I had paid 8 pounds for this back in 1985.
